title: Design System: Stability Tracker Parent App

pressboard.source: @stability/design-tokens caseFile.pressboard.base; ramps live in the world sidecar

tab-gold.purpose: Only what waits on the parent.

pen.purpose: Done ticks and done times only.

hero.purpose: One per screen: greeting or screen title. he/ar: Heebo/Cairo 800, tracking 0.

headline.purpose: Section titles; always lead their block.

lede.purpose: Screen intro line under the hero.

caption.purpose: Tab bar labels, tab labels, sources.

figure-large.purpose: Calendar stamp day, ticket stub time.

stamp.purpose: Dates, now, sent/saved, sample-data notice. en only in mono uppercase tracked; he/ar use the script's own face, no tracking.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: NOW card, slips, open ticket, docked action, Log disc.

motion.name: ease-paper
motion.purpose: All settles, presses, stamps, card hand-off.

motion.name: press-in
motion.purpose: PressCard under the thumb; 0.9 for the pen tick.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: scale 1.3 to 1, 360ms ease-paper, 180ms delay; opacity to 0.92

geometry.name: slip-tilt
geometry.purpose: Hand-placed note, check-in and answer slips.

geometry.name: ticket-notch
geometry.value: 22px circles in sheet at start/end; 1.5px dashed strong-rule tear line

geometry.name: dock
geometry.value: 14px above tab bar, 20px inset; content reserves 128px

geometry.name: glyph-grid
geometry.value: 24px, stroke 1.6; tab bar tint 14% idle, 22% active

narrative.northStar: The Fridge Door (inside The Case File)
narrative.overview: The family's side of the case file lives on the fridge door: cool sheet enamel, picture cards in order, the therapist's notes held up by pressboard magnets, visits as perforated tickets, and a pressboard tab bar the app rests on. Pen ticks mark done; gold marks only what waits on the parent. Set large for one-handed use; trilingual with he/ar mirrored. World doctrine lives in apps/therapist-web/DESIGN.md.
keyCharacteristics: Pressboard board with the active tab joined to the sheet
Pen tick as the single done control
Magnet-held tilted slips; perforated visit tickets
Gold rationed to what waits on the parent
Mono for numerals only; stamps in the script's own face in he/ar

rules.name: The Waiting-On-You Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the parent owes something: unread note, open check-in, unread count.

rules.name: The Pen Is Done Rule
rules.body: Pen blue means finished: ticks and done times only.

rules.name: The Numerals-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets times, counts and day numbers in every language, never words.

rules.name: The Script's Own Stamp Rule
rules.body: In he and ar stamps use the script's own face with no tracking.

rules.name: The Heading-First Rule
rules.body: Headings lead; metadata rows come after them, never kickers.

rules.name: The Held-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: Every lifted slip is held by a magnet, a stub, or the board.

rules.name: The One Tick Rule
rules.body: Every done state is the pen tick; no switches, filled checkboxes or Mark done buttons.

dos: Do put the heading first, then the metadata row.
Do mark every done state with the pen tick.
Do draw new pictures as 48px duotone pictograms.
Do hold lifted slips with a magnet or stub; tilt at most 1.2 degrees.
Do set he/ar stamps in the script's own face, untracked.
Do load sample content through useFamilyContent and isolate() data runs.
Do keep targets at 44px or more.
donts: Don't use gold for anything that does not wait on the parent.
Don't use the tracked stamp as a section label or kicker.
Don't let intensity color shame the family.
Don't build pastel wellness card grids or chat bubbles.
Don't put Geist Mono on words.
Don't join the Log disc to the sheet.
